title: Michael's Choice
description: After failing to defend his friend from a vicious attack, Michael must face the cost of his silence and decide what kind of man he wants to become.
excerpt: Michael has always gone along with the crowd. But when a brutal night ends in tragedy, a final message from his friend forces him to confront the person he has become.
author: from-a-storyteller

card.title: Michael's Choice
card.description: A night of cruelty leaves Michael facing guilt, loss and a choice between following the crowd and becoming someone better.
